subject: Malaysia M-340: masterbatch TDS and a 1 kg sample
body:
For any TiO2-powder assessment alongside your pre-dispersed materials, M-340 is a chloride-process rutile grade. Its TDS lists high-concentration masterbatch and typical TiO2 content of 97% (standard minimum 94%).

Our REACH registration certificate is available for review.

I've attached the M-340 TDS and REACH information for your review.

We can provide a free 1 kg sample.

Shall we arrange a sample for your technical team's evaluation?
